name: Experimental Setup 3
description: Two adjacent Siegmund tables with a UR10e and matching HX5-D20 hand at each front outer corner.
units: m, rad, kg, s; fields suffixed deg are degrees

tables.note: Each table is 1.2 by 0.8 m, touching at x=1.2. Front/lower edge is y=-0.8; +x is right and +y is back.

mount.note: Approximate cylindrical mounts. The Menagerie attachment site is at wrist3 y=0.1; this assembly uses 0.11655 m to align with the UR10e nominal flange and visual face. No hardware-specific mount CAD or extrinsic calibration is available for Exp 3.
